title: OpenAuditModel Audit Event Schema
description: Canonical machine-verifiable structure of an OpenAuditModel audit event. Version 0.1 is experimental. Core objects reject unknown properties: domain-specific data belongs in `metadata`, `extensions`, `attributes`, or in an OpenAuditModel profile.
$comment: Normative reference: specification/event-model.md. Patterns in this schema deliberately avoid look-around and back-references so that they remain portable across ECMA-262, RE2 and PCRE regular expression engines.

specVersion.$comment: Constant in v0.1. The compatibility strategy for later versions is defined in specification/overview.md.
specVersion.description: OpenAuditModel specification version this event conforms to.

id.description: Globally unique, idempotent identifier of this audit event. No identifier technology is mandated; UUIDv4, UUIDv7 or ULID are RECOMMENDED. Receivers MAY use this value to deduplicate redelivered events.

time.description: When the audited operation occurred, as observed by the producing application. UTC is RECOMMENDED.

observedTime.description: When a collector, exporter, gateway or receiving system observed this event. MUST NOT be assumed equal to `time`.

sequence.description: Producer-assigned monotonically increasing ordinal used to order events that share a timestamp. Ordering is only meaningful within a single producer, partition or integrity chain.

actor.description: Principal that technically performed the operation.

subject.description: Principal on whose behalf the actor performed the operation. This is NOT the audited target; the audited target is `resource`.

resource.description: Primary resource the audited operation acted upon.

relatedResources.description: Additional resources affected by, or required to interpret, the same operation.

evidence.description: References to material supporting this event. Evidence is referenced, never embedded.

controlCategories.description: Regulation-neutral control categories this event contributes evidence to. Regulation, framework and jurisdiction identifiers MUST NOT appear here; they belong to external mapping artifacts.

tags.description: Producer-defined labels for filtering and routing. Tags carry no normative meaning.

metadata.description: Domain-specific audit interpretation data that has no core representation. Values SHOULD be small and structured. MUST NOT contain secrets, large payloads or duplicate copies of core fields.

extensions.description: Vendor-specific or domain-specific additions. Every key MUST be a reverse-domain namespaced name of at least three dot-separated segments. Extensions MUST NOT weaken required core fields or redefine the meaning of core fields.

allOf.$comment: Delegation types that act for another principal require that principal to be identified. `service-chain` describes transport-level chaining and does not by itself imply a subject.

jsonValue.title: JSON value
jsonValue.description: Any JSON value: string, number, integer, boolean, null, array or object.

jsonObject.title: JSON object
jsonObject.description: A JSON object whose values may be any JSON value.

identifier.title: Identifier
identifier.description: Opaque, stable identifier. Leading and trailing whitespace are not permitted and the value MUST NOT be empty.

token.title: Vocabulary token
token.description: Lower-case, hyphen-separated vocabulary term. Used for open vocabularies whose recommended values are listed in the semantic conventions.

eventName.title: Event name
eventName.description: Hierarchical lower-case event name in the form domain.resource.action. At least two segments are REQUIRED. Segments may contain hyphenated words such as `offset-reset`. Event names MUST NOT contain product, company or jurisdiction names.

extensionKey.title: Extension key
extensionKey.description: Reverse-domain namespaced extension key with at least three dot-separated lower-case segments, for example `com.example.workflow.stage`.

timestamp.title: Timestamp
timestamp.description: RFC 3339 compatible date-time string. UTC is RECOMMENDED.

text.title: Human readable text
text.description: Short human readable text. MUST NOT contain secrets, credentials, tokens or unnecessary personal data.

algorithmIdentifier.title: Algorithm identifier
algorithmIdentifier.description: Cryptographic algorithm identifier. The vocabulary is intentionally open so that new algorithms may be adopted without a specification change.

digest.title: Digest
digest.description: Encoded hash or signature value produced by another system or layer, such as an evidence digest or a signature. Hexadecimal, base64 and base64url encodings are accepted, because the value is often echoed from the system that produced it. Digests that OpenAuditModel itself verifies use `hexDigest` instead.

hexDigest.title: Verifiable digest
hexDigest.description: Digest that OpenAuditModel tooling recalculates and compares, encoded as lower-case hexadecimal with an even number of digits. A single encoding is mandated because a digest that could be hexadecimal or base64 cannot be compared without guessing. See specification/integrity.md §5.

traceId.title: Trace identifier
traceId.description: W3C Trace Context trace-id: 32 lower-case hexadecimal characters. The all-zero value is invalid.

spanId.title: Span identifier
spanId.description: W3C Trace Context parent-id: 16 lower-case hexadecimal characters. The all-zero value is invalid.

eventDescriptor.title: Event descriptor
eventDescriptor.description: What happened and how it ended.

category.description: Coarse grouping of the event name. Open vocabulary; recommended values are listed in semantic-conventions/event-naming.md.

type.description: Optional activity classifier that is independent of the domain, such as the coarse operation performed.

outcome.description: Result of the audited operation. `partial` describes an operation that succeeded for some targets and failed for others.

severity.description: Audit significance of the event, not the severity of a software fault.

summary.description: Short human readable description. Machine consumers MUST NOT parse this field.

allOf.$comment: A failed operation carries a sanitized error descriptor so that failures remain analyzable without free-text parsing.

errorDescriptor.title: Error descriptor
errorDescriptor.description: Sanitized description of why an operation failed. MUST NOT contain secrets, tokens, credentials, personal data, full payloads, or internal stack traces unless explicitly permitted by policy.

code.description: Stable, machine-readable failure code defined by the producing application.

retryable.description: Whether the same operation may reasonably succeed if retried.

principal.title: Principal
principal.description: An actor or a subject. Stable identifiers are sufficient; personally identifiable display names are never required.

type.description: Kind of principal. A principal that does not fit a core type SHOULD use the closest core type and describe the detail in `attributes`.

id.description: Stable identifier of the principal within its issuing authority. SHOULD NOT be an email address or another direct personal identifier when a stable opaque identifier exists.

displayName.description: OPTIONAL human readable name. Personal data; include only when required by the audit purpose.

tenantId.description: Tenant the principal belongs to, when the application is multi-tenant.

roles.description: Roles held by the principal that are relevant to this operation. This is not a complete role inventory.

attributes.description: Additional producer-defined principal attributes. MUST NOT contain credentials or unnecessary personal data.

delegation.title: Delegation
delegation.description: How authority to perform the operation was transferred from the subject to the actor.

type.description: `impersonation`: the actor assumed the subject's identity. `on-behalf-of`: the actor acted for the subject with its own identity. `delegated`: authority was granted in advance. `service-chain`: the operation traversed intermediate services.

reference.description: Identifier of the grant, ticket or session that authorized the delegation.

approvedBy.description: Principal that approved the delegation, when delegation required approval.

resourceReference.title: Resource
resourceReference.description: A resource the operation acted upon. Resource types are an open vocabulary and MUST NOT be enumerated in the core schema.

id.description: Stable identifier of the resource within the producing application.

name.description: OPTIONAL human readable resource name. May itself be sensitive.

parentId.description: Identifier of the containing resource, such as a folder, project or cluster.

classification.description: Data classification of the resource. Open vocabulary because classification schemes are organization-defined. Recommended values: public, internal, confidential, restricted, secret, unknown.

ownerId.description: Identifier of the owning principal or team.

attributes.description: Additional producer-defined resource attributes. MUST NOT contain resource contents.

application.title: Application context
application.description: The application that produced the event. This MUST describe the producer, not a collector, forwarder or storage backend.

name.description: Stable name of the producing application. Lower-case hyphenated names are RECOMMENDED.

environment.description: Deployment environment. Open vocabulary. Recommended values: local, development, test, staging, production, disaster-recovery, unknown.

instance.description: Identifier of the specific running instance, such as a pod, host or process.

service.description: Service within the application that produced the event.

component.description: Component or module within the service.

region.description: Deployment region identifier as defined by the operator.

zone.description: Deployment zone identifier as defined by the operator.

deploymentId.description: Identifier of the deployment or release the instance is running.

organization.title: Organization context
organization.description: OPTIONAL organizational placement of the operation. Not every application is multi-tenant, so this object is never required.

authentication.title: Authentication context
authentication.description: How the actor was authenticated. Absence of this object means authentication context is not available or not applicable; it does NOT mean the actor was anonymous.

mfa.description: Whether multi-factor authentication was satisfied for the session behind this operation.

assuranceLevel.description: Producer-defined authentication assurance level. Values are application-defined; mapping to an external assurance framework is out of scope for the core specification.

sessionId.description: Session correlation identifier. MUST NOT be a usable session token or cookie value.

authenticatedAt.description: When the session behind this operation was authenticated.

authorization.title: Authorization context
authorization.description: The authorization decision that permitted or denied the operation. OpenAuditModel records decisions; it is not an authorization engine.

engine.description: Component that produced the decision. No specific engine is required or implied.

policy.description: Identifier of the policy that produced the decision.

policyVersion.description: Version of the policy that produced the decision.

permissions.description: Permissions that were evaluated or required for the operation.

approval.title: Approval context
approval.description: Human or workflow approval associated with the operation. Approval is distinct from authorization: authorization is a policy evaluation, approval is a decision by one or more principals.

status.description: State of the approval at the time of the event.

workflowId.description: Identifier of the approval workflow definition or instance.

requiredApprovals.description: Number of approvals required by policy.

receivedApprovals.description: Number of approvals received at the time of the event.

approvedAt.description: When the approval reached its current status.

request.title: Request and correlation context
request.description: How the operation was requested and how it correlates with other telemetry.

requestId.description: Identifier of the request that triggered the operation.

correlationId.description: Identifier correlating a set of related requests or operations.

ipAddress.description: Network address the request originated from. Personal data in most jurisdictions; record only when the audit purpose requires it.

forwardedFor.description: Ordered list of proxy-reported client addresses. Structured deliberately so that raw forwarding headers are not copied verbatim.

userAgent.description: Client user agent string, truncated by the producer when necessary.

protocol.description: Application protocol used for the request. Open vocabulary.

method.description: Protocol-level operation, such as an HTTP method or an RPC verb.

route.description: Route template rather than a resolved URL. Query strings and fragments are rejected so that identifiers and search terms are not captured incidentally.

change.title: Change context
change.description: What the operation changed. Complete before and after states are never required: changed fields, sanitized state, hashes or references are all acceptable.

changedFields.description: Paths of the fields that changed. Field paths alone are often sufficient and avoid recording values.

before.description: Sanitized prior state or the subset of it that changed. MUST NOT contain full database records, credentials or sensitive payloads.

after.description: Sanitized resulting state or the subset of it that changed. MUST NOT contain full database records, credentials or sensitive payloads.

beforeHash.description: Digest of the prior state, for verification without disclosure.

afterHash.description: Digest of the resulting state, for verification without disclosure.

ticketId.description: Change or service ticket associated with the change.

deploymentId.description: Deployment or release associated with the change.

reason.title: Reason
reason.description: Why the operation was performed. This is a business justification and MUST NOT be confused with a technical error message.

code.description: Machine-readable justification code from a producer-defined vocabulary.

reference.description: Identifier or locator of the record that justifies the operation, such as a ticket or case.

evidenceItem.title: Evidence reference
evidenceItem.description: A reference to supporting material. OpenAuditModel does not define evidence storage. References MUST be access-controlled and MUST NOT embed credentials.

reference.description: Locator or identifier of the evidence in its own system. MUST NOT contain credentials, tokens or signed access parameters.

hash.description: Digest of the referenced evidence, allowing later verification that it was not altered.

contentType.description: Media type of the referenced evidence.

retentionUntil.description: When the evidence may be disposed of, according to the owning system.

legalHold.description: Whether the evidence is currently under a hold that suspends disposal.

privacy.title: Privacy context
privacy.description: How this event relates to personal data. Regulation-specific fields MUST NOT be added here; regulatory interpretation belongs to external mapping artifacts.

containsPersonalData.description: Whether the event as serialized contains personal data.

dataCategories.description: Categories of personal data present. Open vocabulary; recommended values are listed in specification/privacy.md.

processing.description: How personal data was handled when the event was produced.

minimized.description: Whether the producer applied data minimization to this event.

retentionClass.description: Producer-defined retention class governing this event.

purpose.description: Purpose for which the event is recorded.

integrity.title: Integrity context
integrity.description: Tamper-evidence material for this event. Integrity metadata makes alteration detectable; it does not make events immutable, prevent deletion, or replace write-once storage.

canonicalization.description: Canonicalization applied before hashing. `RFC8785`, the JSON Canonicalization Scheme, is the identifier the OpenAuditModel verifier implements. REQUIRED when `hash` is present: a digest whose canonicalization is unknown cannot be recalculated.

hashAlgorithm.description: Algorithm used to produce `hash` and `previousHash`. Open vocabulary, matched case-sensitively; the v0.1 verifier implements SHA-256, SHA-384 and SHA-512. Acceptance by this schema is not a claim of verifier support.

hash.description: Digest of the canonicalized event, calculated over the event with `/integrity/hash` and `/integrity/signature` removed. See specification/integrity.md §4.

previousHash.description: Digest of the preceding event in the same chain, forming a tamper-evident sequence. Every event in one chain MUST use the same `hashAlgorithm` and `canonicalization`.

chainId.description: Identifier of the chain this event belongs to. Chains may be per instance, per partition or per batch; a single global chain is NOT required.

batchId.description: Identifier of the batch this event was sealed with.

signature.title: Signature
signature.description: Digital signature over the canonicalized event. A signature does not by itself create legal evidentiary status, and key management is outside the core specification.

algorithm.description: Signature algorithm. Open vocabulary; recommended values include Ed25519, ECDSA-P256-SHA256 and RSA-PSS-SHA256.

keyId.description: Identifier of the verification key. MUST NOT contain key material.
